role: The hand-labelled cases the permission phrase list is bounded by. A case is the FINAL agent message of a take the driver stopped, and its hand label is what a reader of that message decides, under Javier's ruling J3 (13 September 2026) that a stop which only reports lacking permission counts.
not_a_claim: A case records how a message reads, never how a model behaves; the counts per model are in verification/round1-regrade/permission-stop.json.
binding: round-1 stops name their take by task, half, model and take number, and templates by contract and template id; both are bound to the sha256 of the text they name and are read from the committed files at test time. Hand variants carry their text.
